items.summary: Update the Dashboard page to include a new "Notes" overview stat card placed in the second row, positioned next to the existing "Meeting Attendance" stat card (so the second row contains two stat cards side-by-side below the first four cards).

Implement the "Notes" stat card UI to match the existing stat card sizing and hover/click behavior, with these specifics: title text "Notes"; a note/document-style icon from the existing icon set; dark grey background (#374151 or #4B5563); white text for contrast; show the total global notes count across the entire app formatted like "12 notes" with the numeric count displayed large.
Wire the Notes stat card to navigate to the Notes page route "/notes" when clicked, using the same routing approach as the other dashboard stat cards.

Fetch the global notes list on the Dashboard using the existing global notes query hook and use it to compute the Notes stat card total; include the notes query loading state in the Dashboard loading gate so the card does not render stale/undefined counts while data is still loading.
